name: Potauf Tokrev
source:
Potauf Tokrev is a member of the Helman Revolutionary Army that rised up in LP0006 to take down Stessel from power and give Prince Patton his legitimate place in the throne.

A member of the army itself commanded by Hanty Kalar to serve as a decoy army, Potauf is a key member. He's notorious for his incredible similarity to the Prince Patton himself, to the point he could perfectly be mistaken for a lost son of the Emperor. He was originally meant to be a cook, but his outstanding resemblance to Patton made him an ideal Body Double to serve as a decoy, attracting those wishing to take the Head of the Army.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.miraheze.org/wiki/Potauf_Tokrev]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
